title: Why Do We Play Sports? Team Spirit Starts Here

lingo.name: Lingo
lingo.persona: warm, playful owl teacher, bright and encouraging

zip.name: Zip
zip.persona: energetic 11-year-old squirrel, fast-talking, proud of his team

rosa.name: Rosa
rosa.persona: calm, careful 11-year-old squirrel, thoughtful and kind

focusWords.kidDefinition: A school lesson where you run, jump and play sports.
examples: I love PE because we play games in the sunshine.
Our PE teacher gives us a new game every Monday.
focusWords.greekHint: PE = Φυσική Αγωγή: φυσική αγωγή, γυμναστική, κίνηση.

focusWords.kidDefinition: A group of people who play a sport together.
examples: Our soccer team practises four times a week.
Everyone in our team wears the same blue shirt.
focusWords.greekHint: team = ομάδα: μία ομάδα, όλοι μαζί.

focusWords.kidDefinition: A special character or animal that makes a team fun.
examples: Our team mascot is a big pink bird.
The mascot waves at the crowd before every match.
focusWords.greekHint: mascot = μασκότ: το σύμβολο της ομάδας.

focusWords.kidDefinition: To keep your body healthy and strong through exercise.
examples: Jerry goes jogging three times a week to keep in shape.
Swimming is a great way to stay in shape.
focusWords.greekHint: stay in shape = κρατιέμαι σε φόρμα.

focusWords.kidDefinition: To take part in a race or game against other people.
examples: Tom first competed in a professional match two years ago.
Ten runners will compete in the big race tomorrow.
focusWords.greekHint: compete = διαγωνίζομαι: παίρνω μέρος σε αγώνα.

focusWords.kidDefinition: To be the best in a game or race.
examples: When Anna won the trophy, she was extremely happy.
Did your team win the match on Saturday?

focusWords.kidDefinition: Practice that helps you get better at a sport.
examples: You need a lot more training before you can join big matches.
Morning training makes me stronger every day.
focusWords.greekHint: training = προπόνηση: η εξάσκηση πριν τον αγώνα.

focusWords.kidDefinition: Being protected from harm or danger.
examples: Always wear a helmet for your safety when you cycle.
Safety comes first when we go climbing on the rocks.

lines.text: Hello, friends! I am Lingo, and I love sport!
Do you run, jump, or climb in your free time?
Today we find out why people play sports.
Some people play for fun. Some play to win trophies!
Let's meet two friends from the Speedy Squirrels story.

question.text: What is your favourite sport, and why do you like it?

scenes.title: Zip and Rosa at the Park

caption.text: Zip and Rosa stand by the big oak tree, ready for the race.

speech.text: Our team is ready to compete in the big race!
Yes! But first we need training, so let's stay in shape.

caption.text: Rosa checks the helmets. Zip waves at their mascot, a pink bird.

speech.text: Remember, safety comes first. Helmets on, please!
Then we can win the trophy together, Rosa!

prompt.text: Point to the word for the special character that cheers for the team.

explain.text: A mascot is the special animal or character that represents a team.

prompt.text: Listen: Safety first! Point to the word you hear.

explain.text: Safety means being protected from harm, so we always wear our helmets.

prompt.text: We do ____ every day to get better before the big match.

explain.text: Training is the practice we do to improve at a sport.

prompt.text: Jerry runs three times a week to ____, so he feels strong and healthy.

explain.text: To stay in shape means keeping your body fit and healthy.

prompt.text: A team is a group of people who play together. True or false?

explain.text: Everyone in a team works together towards the same goal.

prompt.text: Which word is the odd one out?

explain.text: Win is the odd one out because it means to be the best, but compete, training and climbing are activities you do.

prompt.text: To compete means to take part in a race or game. True or false?

explain.text: When you compete, you play or race against other people.

prompt.text: Point to the word for the school lesson where you run and play sports.

explain.text: PE is the school lesson where we move, play games and do sport.

lines.text: Let's play a memory game! Match each word with its picture.
Say the word out loud each time you find a pair.

prompt.text: Tell your partner about a sport you like, and why it is good for you.

frames: I like ___ because it helps me stay in shape.
In my school, ___ is my favourite lesson.
One day, I would like to compete with my ___.

model.text: I like swimming because it helps me stay in shape. In my school, PE is my favourite lesson. One day, I would like to compete with my team.

lines.text: Brilliant work today, super sports stars!
You now know words like team, training, compete and win.
Next time, we will read about the Olympics and find out more.

exitTicket.text: Why do you think people play sports? Use one word from today.
What is one way you can keep safe when you do sport?
